verdict.rationale: Weaviate offers a managed cloud deployment: Weaviate Cloud is listed as a deployment option, there is an always-free tier of one cluster per user, and some features are Cloud-only (the Query Agent and natural-language answers). Nothing in the evidence shows clusters can be provisioned programmatically, for example through a management API, CLI or Terraform provider. Missing for 10: documented programmatic cluster provisioning, details of the managed-service operations, and independent hands-on corroboration of the cloud offering.
